hypotheses_high_force.statistic: free censored fit log F = c + e_v log v + e_beta log beta over the high-force archive's upper-boundary columns (t 0.2, K 2, measured window force); level = censored single offset vs each frozen model (B T2 Z 1.1899 unless the archive metadata names another string; then that string's published Z).
hypotheses_high_force.H_thermal: e_beta >= -0.95 (T1k_break predicts about -0.92 on the high-force grid; T1k_peak about -0.85)
hypotheses_high_force.speed: thermal T1k_break predicts e_v about +0.87-0.9 on the high-force grid (rises with F v); S1 +1.00; E3 +0.70
hypotheses_high_force.decision: the hypothesis whose interval contains the point estimate is 'supported'; bootstrap 95 % CI reported; if the CI spans two hypotheses -> 'not decidable'

scoring_rule: Primary per target: model level error = thermal_law.offset_fit(target upper columns, base = frozen model); |error| within model_level_error_pi90 = 'within PI'. Thermal (T1k_break, T1mu) vs plain S1_strict: smaller |error| wins only if the difference is >= 0.03 log, else 'not distinguishable'. Also held-out mean censored NLL per column with the frozen sigma (analysis.score). Secondary: level_A (censored offset vs base_A) vs level_A_pred +- model_level_error_pi90; exponents (free_fit) vs e_v, e_beta (model evaluated over the target's own columns at scoring; values here use the donor design) +- PI90. Versioning as in FROZEN_v1: a target is scored against the latest freeze created before its processing start in replicate.log.
